text: Pre-nation crafting screen (Camp era): Planks/Bricks show 'Locked: The Workshop is unlocked in the Village era.' and header explains it. #356 fix looks correct.

Sell Resources in Bigport (0/8 stalls): red toast 'This settlement does not have any stalls.' Clear why, but no hint of what to do next (e.g. 'press B to build a stall' or which settlement has stalls). Settlement name banner 'Town of Bigport / 7 here, 11/32 residents' is clipped at the top edge.

Sell Resources in Bigport with 1 merchant stall (0 coins): red toast 'No merchant here can pay: the richest has 0 coins, and your cheapest good (sapling) sells for 19.' Clear reason. Oddity: it names saplings as my cheapest good though Market Info lists no sapling price and the button's enable check only looks at wood/stone/planks/bricks.

After disbanding my nation (L, L), Objective 4 'Found a settlement' says 'Only a leader can found one. Wait for yours, or press L then N to lead.' I have no nation, so 'wait for yours' and 'press L' don't apply; should say 'Press N to start a nation'.

No nation, inside AI Town of Bigport: crafting header 'In the Town of Bigport, which has a Workshop: every recipe is open' and Planks/Bricks are craftable. Works, but out in the world the locked text only says 'The Workshop is unlocked in the Village era', never that visiting a town with a Workshop also works - a new player would think planks are impossible until Village era.

Just after founding, a nearby pawn's floating label 'Xavier Watson / Ambitious / (gathering resources)' renders in huge letters covering the middle of the screen (and the settlement banner '0 here, 3/8 residents' clipped at top).
In own Camp, 'Build Stall' button is greyed out with no hover tooltip or cost shown; only pressing B reveals 'Not enough wood. Need 13 more.' The disabled button should say why / show the cost.

Successful Sell Resources in own Camp (4 pawn stalls, 80 coins): +65 coins, sold 1 wood, 1 stone, 1 apple. The 'You sold resources to X' status was immediately replaced by a diplomacy toast ('Bigtown resents your border...') so the player never sees what was sold or to whom; only a faint '+65 coins' float.

Could not set up the 'only my own stall' case: my new Camp's market went 0/4 -> 4/4 stalls, all owned by pawns, within ~60 game seconds of founding (before I could gather the 20 wood for B). 'B' then says 'Market is full. Cannot build stall.' and no stall is for sale. Pawns crowd the player out of their own market.

Objective 6 'Build a market stall' completed at tick 11002 (+50 coins) without me building anything: a pawn (Xavier Watson) built a stall in my camp. Credit for a pawn's action; the player never learns how to build a stall (B, 20 wood + stone).

Empty inventory inside Town of Townham (0/8 stalls): Sell Resources button is greyed out and clicking/hovering it shows nothing. No tooltip or status says why (e.g. 'You have nothing to sell'). The refusal is silent.

Carrying only 5 chicken meat (no wood/stone) inside Village of Greenham, whose Market Info lists 'Chicken Meat 57/51' and 1 merchant: Sell Resources is greyed out and clicking does nothing, no reason given. Market shows a price for my goods but refuses to buy them. Same for apples/saplings-only inventories (the button's enable check looks only at wood/stone/planks/bricks, while the earlier refusal text counted saplings as goods). Also '2/6 stalls' but only 1 merchant listed.
